title: Black Lentil Arayes
subtitle: grilled pita with roasted vegetables and yoghurt
description: A vegan take on the Nazareth classic: pita filled with spiced black lentils and charred on the grill until crisp. Serve with grilled vegetables and yoghurt.

steps.text: Fry the finely chopped onion and diced carrot in the olive oil for a few minutes. Add the lentils and fry for about 3 minutes. Add the baharat and the vegetable stock (or water), bring to the boil, then reduce the heat.
Cover and cook for about 45 minutes.
Drain the lentils and mash the mixture lightly with a spoon.
Season with salt and pepper, stir in the chopped parsley, and chill for 2 hours.
Cut the pitas in half and fill them with the lentil mixture.
Grill the pita halves on a hot charcoal grill for about 2 minutes each side (including the opening). Serve with grilled vegetables and yoghurt.
